<style>
#quarto-header, .navbar, .quarto-navbar, .page-footer, .nav-footer { display: none !important; }

.cv-download {

}

.cv-download a {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 0.5rem 1.2rem;

  color: white !important;

  font-family: "EB Garamond", Georgia, serif;
  font-size: 1rem;
  transition: background-color 0.2s ease;
}

.cv-download a:hover {
  background-color: #6B0000;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.cv-pdf-container {
  width: 100%;
  border: 1px solid #dee2e6;
  border-radius: 0.5rem;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
}

.cv-pdf-container iframe {
  width: 100%;
  height: 85vh;
  border: none;
}

@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
  .cv-pdf-container { border-color: #495057; }
}

body.quarto-dark .cv-pdf-container,
html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .cv-pdf-container { border-color: #495057; }

@media (max-width: 650px) {

}
